_readme: One record per research piece. Edit this file only; see docs/RESEARCH-SOCIAL-POSTING.md. Empty string = fact not confirmed; the page shows nothing for it.

pieces.title: A Watershed Moment for News Deserts
pieces.dek: Medill's map shows where local news has dried up. Look closer and information is still moving — across county lines, and through platforms, beats and forms the count doesn't see.

hero_image.alt: A desert of rippled sand dunes under a turquoise sky. A narrow dark shaft rises from the horizon into a wedge of dark red ground heaped with paper strips, each printed with a word or name from local news: independent, journalism, planning board, Brandon Reporter, livestream, who's funding state rep.

pieces.title: Nodes and Networks
pieces.dek: A field study of 169 U.S. journalism organizations: how governance, more than platform, beat or geography, predicts how big they get.

pieces.title: Creator Journalism Toolkit
pieces.dek: A practical field guide for independent journalists in Chicago — produced with Press Forward Chicago and the Chicago Community Trust. Maps the creator journalism landscape, identifies infrastructure gaps, and provides actionable guidance for building sustainable independent ventures.

pieces.title: The 2025 News Ecosystem Map
pieces.dek: An interactive graphic mapping the full spectrum of where news content is being produced and distributed today — from established legacy media to creator-model journalists to news influencers. Presented at ISOJ 2025, Knight Media Forum, and referenced across industry research.

pieces.title: US Indie Info Providers: Professionally Diverse, Mission-driven, Sometimes Lonely, Rarely Earning Profit
pieces.dek: A first look at the people shaping independent information in the US. 26 creators interviewed. Project C provided recruitment, field knowledge, and expertise throughout the research process.
